source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.note: League-wide: the extension covers BAL games each season, with the 2026 Playoffs and Finals at BK Arena in Kigali, and Visit Rwanda showcased on BAL team uniforms.
source.quote: Through the agreement, Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine.

source.name: The BAL (bal.nba.com): BAL names PUMA as league's official outfitter ahead of 2026 season
source.note: Kit maker. League-wide outfitter: the collaboration begins with the 2026 BAL season and PUMA supplies the game uniforms of all BAL teams, so the Puma mark on the FUS Rabat jersey and shorts is league branding, not a club deal.
source.quote: will see PUMA supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms, warm-up gear, practice wear, accessories, and branded tops

summary: League-issued BAL 2026 uniform: PUMA is the league's official outfitter (supplies the game uniforms of all BAL teams) and Visit Rwanda (Rwanda Development Board) is showcased on BAL team uniforms league-wide. No club-level shirt sponsor found for the 2026 season; the complete placement list on the FUS Rabat jersey is not yet confirmed from photos.
